title: Water Lilies
description: A pond becomes a world of its own. In this late Water Lilies painting, Monet returns to the water garden he created at his home in Giverny.
detail: Look at how floating leaves, reflections and open water share the same surface. With no horizon to anchor the scene, your eye can wander through the colour and loose brushwork. Take a moment to notice where the water ends and its reflection begins.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 437137
chineseIntroduction: 《睡莲》，克劳德·莫奈，1916至1919年，布面油画。这幅晚期作品描绘了莫奈在吉维尼家中营造的水上花园。画面没有明显的地平线，睡莲、倒影与水面融为一体。请放慢脚步，观察色彩与笔触，感受水面和倒影之间若隐若现的边界。

title: The Harvesters
description: Golden fields open onto a distant landscape. Some harvesters work through the late-summer heat while others pause in the shade of a tree.
detail: Bruegel brings ordinary life into a sweeping view of the changing seasons. Follow the paths between the fields, then return to the small gestures of the people in the foreground. Work, rest and landscape all belong to the same rhythm.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 435809
chineseIntroduction: 《收割者》，老彼得·勃鲁盖尔，1565年，木板油画。金色麦田延伸至远处的风景。有人在夏日里劳动，有人在树荫下休息。请沿着田间的小路观察，再回到前景人物的姿态，感受劳动、休息与季节的节奏。

title: The Dancing Class
description: Step into a ballet rehearsal. Degas looks beyond the performance to the quiet concentration, waiting and practice that happen behind the scenes.
detail: Notice the open floor and the way the figures are gathered around it. Small changes in posture suggest a moment caught in passing. Look for the contrast between the dancers’ delicate clothing and the discipline of their movements.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 436141
chineseIntroduction: 《舞蹈课》，埃德加·德加，约1870年，木板油画。作品带我们走进芭蕾排练室，观察表演背后的练习、等待与专注。请留意空旷的地板、人物的分布，以及轻盈舞裙与严谨姿态之间的对比。

title: Wheat Field with Cypresses
description: Golden wheat, dark cypresses and a restless sky fill this landscape painted during Van Gogh’s time in Saint-Rémy. The scene brings together the trees and fields that occupied him in the summer of 1889.
detail: Follow the changing direction of the brushstrokes, from the low field to the rising trees and curling clouds. Where do the colours feel warm, and where do they become cool? This is an invitation to look, rather than a claim about the artist’s state of mind.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 436535
chineseIntroduction: 《柏树麦田》，文森特·梵高，1889年，布面油画。这幅风景作于梵高在圣雷米生活的时期。金色麦田、深色柏树与天空构成鲜明对照。请沿着笔触的方向，从田野看到树木和云层，观察冷暖色彩如何改变画面的节奏。

title: Young Woman with a Water Pitcher
description: A woman stands beside an open window with a pitcher and basin. Vermeer turns an everyday domestic moment into a careful arrangement of light, fabric and reflective surfaces.
detail: Look for the light on the linen covering her head and on the metal pitcher. Compare those bright areas with the quieter shadows. What do you notice first, and how does the window guide your attention through the room?
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 437881
chineseIntroduction: 《持水壶的年轻女子》，约翰内斯·维米尔，约1662年，布面油画。一名女子站在敞开的窗边，身旁摆着水壶和盆。请观察头巾上的光线、金属器皿的反光和房间里的阴影，体会画家如何通过光线组织一个日常生活片刻。

title: The Card Players
description: Figures gather around a card table in a scene Cézanne developed from studies of local farmworkers. Their poses and the arrangement of the furniture give the ordinary game a strong sense of structure.
detail: Trace the upright figures, the table edge and the shapes of the coats. Notice how small patches of colour give variety to an apparently still scene. Try comparing this work’s composition with the movement in Van Gogh’s landscape.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 435868
chineseIntroduction: 《玩牌者》，保罗·塞尚，1890至1892年，布面油画。塞尚根据当地农场工人的人物习作构思了这个场景。请留意人物、桌子和衣服形成的形状，观察细小色块如何让安静的画面产生变化，也可以与梵高风景中的动感作比较。

title: Madame Georges Charpentier and Her Children
description: Marguerite Charpentier sits with her children, Georgette and Paul, in their Paris home. Renoir’s commissioned portrait includes the family dog and the richly decorated sitting room.
detail: Compare the textures of the dress, the children’s clothing and the furnishings. Follow the figures’ positions across the room: how does Renoir connect a formal portrait with the feeling of a family gathering? The display title is shortened from The Met’s full catalogue title.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 438815
chineseIntroduction: 《夏庞蒂埃夫人和她的孩子们》，奥古斯特·雷诺阿，1878年，布面油画。这幅受委托创作的肖像描绘了玛格丽特·夏庞蒂埃和孩子乔治特、保罗，也画入了家中的狗与客厅陈设。请比较衣服和家具的质感，观察人物的位置如何连接整个画面。此处作品名采用简写。

title: Self-Portrait with a Straw Hat
description: Van Gogh made this self-portrait while living in Paris. Using himself as a model gave him a way to practise figure painting; this portrait shares its canvas with an earlier study on the other side.
detail: Notice the short strokes around the face, hat and background. Compare the colours placed next to one another rather than blending them together. The display title is shortened; The Met’s full title also identifies the painting on the other side, The Potato Peeler.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 436532
chineseIntroduction: 《戴草帽的自画像》，文森特·梵高，1887年，布面油画。梵高在巴黎期间以自己为模特练习人物绘画，这幅肖像与另一面的早期人物习作共用一块画布。请观察脸部、草帽和背景周围的短笔触，以及相邻颜色形成的对比。此处作品名采用简写。
